docs.summary: How the display turns the images when [`PreRotate`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.SwapchainDescription~PreRotate) is set, so the host draws rotated the other way. Identity otherwise.

Whether the swapchain has a surface to present to. A lost surface, as when an Android app goes to the background, lets it go and frames present nothing until [`AttachSurface`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Swapchain~AttachSurface). Do not draw to the framebuffer meanwhile.
Lets the surface and its images go, before the window that owns it is destroyed. The device stays.
